reviews.comment: AI review approved with 8 non-blocking suggestions. Implementation matches spec end-to-end; all gates green; smoke-tested live. See REVIEW.md for follow-ups (graceful 413, dedup of event frames, consolidate dual status systems, rename migrate-hooks, add HTTP test).

Round 2 approved. All 8 round-1 non-blockers addressed; build + typecheck + 53 tests pass; live-verified hook alias, 400/413 paths, distinct title glyphs. 4 minor follow-ups noted for future tasks (dashboard indicator unification, hook alias selectivity, health probe, sync file reads).
Blocker: false 'agent done' notification fires when agent is still active (Stop hook = turn end, not task done). Fix wording or gating before merge.

Blocker 2: master server status badge stays 'idle + stale' while project is actively worked on. Round-2 fix #3 removed legacy activity-engine status push to master; new /log/events path requires the project-local insight-flow binary, but hooks invoke the globally installed (pre-N68) binary which has no /log/events POST. Fix needs to restore a fallback push, repoint hooks at local dist, or document the upgrade dependency.

fix.comment: Blocker 1: reworded 'Claude finished' → 'Awaiting input' (and 'Claude needs permission' → 'Permission required') in both fireStatusDesktopNotif and fireDesktopNotif. Stop hook = turn ended, not task complete; new wording reflects that. Blocker 2: activity-engine events now feed eventStore.insert via a synthetic HookEventInput so master receives status pushes through the unified derivation even when hooks call an unmigrated global CLI binary. Both fixes verified: build + typecheck clean, all 53 tests pass, dashboard restarted on 6006.

reviews.comment: Blocker 3: master server rejects 'done'/'awaiting-permission' as invalid status (validates against active|idle|permission-required only). Badge stays on last accepted value. Fix needs translation at push site or widening master's accepted set.

fix.comment: Blocker 3: widened master server's accepted Claude status vocabulary from 3-state (active|idle|permission-required) to 5-state (added done, awaiting-permission). Updated MasterProjectState type, VALID_STATUSES set, 400-error message, overview CSS (.claude-status-done, .claude-status-awaiting-permission) + render branches. Master + project server restarted; live curl probe: all 5 valid statuses return 200, 'bogus' returns 400 as expected. Backwards-compat: legacy 3-state pushes still work.

reviews.comment: Round 4 approved. All 3 blockers from human-review rounds resolved end-to-end: notification wording honest, activity-engine feeds unified EventStore, master server accepts 4-state vocabulary natively. Live-verified: 5 valid statuses → 200, bogus → 400. 53 tests pass. 5 minor non-blocking observations recorded for future cleanup.
